metadata.description: SYNTHETIC PLACEHOLDER -- deliberately-crafted regression fixture, NOT live-captured and not intended to be: iOS app with RenewalDate in no-timezone format (bug repro for internal-ticket). The UEM API returns timestamps like "2024-01-15T00:00:00.000" (no Z, no offset) for RenewalDate, which fails RFC3339 parsing in Go unless handled specially. Relocated 2026-08-06 from testdata/mock-responses/mam-apps/apps_get_internal_ios_renewaldate.json (left in place, unmodified, for CI existence checks and the default non-override test run -- this copy is the one actually loaded by TestMamV1InternalAppGetByIdRenewalDateFixture via the bypass mechanism in tests/bypass_fixture_helper_test.go, which also sidesteps a header-version collision against a v2-only fixture present in the vendored tree at the same {applicationId} template).
metadata.bug: RenewalDate format is "2006-01-02T15:04:05.000" (no timezone) — not RFC3339
